label: synthetic_reference_judgment
authored_by: the JanSanket project team, by reading each synthetic document; not a public-health expert panel
note: For each of the 60 synthetic development documents: which facet(s) of a verification (verification_guidance, case_definition, epidemiological_context, regional_context) its CONTENT speaks to, 2 = highly and 1 = partially. A document that names a syndrome applies only to that syndrome. Whether a document may be presented (current, verified, English, in force, in the right place) is decided separately by the evaluation oracle, not by this table. This table is synthetic and shares its vocabulary with the pipeline: agreement with retrieval is expected and is not evidence about real evidence.

syn-ads-case-definition.justification: Defines a suspected acute diarrhoeal case and a cluster: the case-definition facet for that syndrome.

syn-ads-clinical-reference.justification: Context on condition families presenting as acute diarrhoeal illness, stating the signal is not a diagnosis.

syn-ads-odisha-context.justification: Odisha monsoon factors that local teams review with acute diarrhoeal illness reports.

syn-ads-situation-report.justification: Weekly situation report with notified suspected acute diarrhoeal cases.

syn-ads-verification-exact-copy.justification: Word-for-word copy of the primary verification guidance from a lower-tier publisher: redundant, not additional evidence.

syn-ads-verification-guidance.justification: Step-by-step procedure for verifying a reported acute diarrhoeal cluster.

syn-ads-verification-guidance-2022.justification: Earlier edition of the verification procedure; relevant in content but superseded.

syn-ads-verification-guidance-2025.justification: Current edition of the verification procedure for acute diarrhoeal clusters.
